name: undoomscroll
description: Interrupts doomscrolling with German ↔ Chinese flashcards.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --start-url https://www.reddit.com
scripts.start:android: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist -t firefox-android
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.fixture: npm run build && esbuild fixtures/harness.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=fixtures/harness.js && echo http://localhost:8766/fixtures/ && python -m http.server 8766
